profile_text.body:
X Corp is a for-profit startup founded in 2023 and headquartered in Bastrop, Texas, operating at x.com. Its site presents the service as a destination for breaking news and entertainment, sports and politics, with live commentary. The page opens with a sign-in prompt for an email address or username and states that continuing means agreeing to the Terms of Service, Privacy Policy and Cookie Use.

The site footer links to About, Get App, Grok, Help, Terms, Privacy, Cookies, Careers, Ads & Business, Developers, News, US TIDA and Accessibility, and carries a 2026 X Corp copyright notice. Grok is the only product name that appears in the site text.

The company's legal exposure is recorded in Texas, with a count of 125.
